dedupe_keys.name: co2 pipeline data catalog netl 2022 spreadsheet of public datasets for co2 transport infrastructure and risk modelling

description: The CO2 pipeline data catalog is a spreadsheet compiled by the US National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL) that lists public spatial and non-spatial datasets relevant to developing and modelling the risks of carbon dioxide transport pipelines. The OSTI record read on 2026-09-28 describes it as an Excel catalogue of collected datasets covering CO2 sources, storage sinks and transportation, published in March 2022 by Devin Justman, Lucy Romeo and Jennifer Bauer with the DOI 10.18141/1860357, which resolves to NETL's Energy Data eXchange. Coverage is mainly the United States. Access is free download; the licence is not stated on the OSTI record. Caveats: it is a catalogue of other datasets, so each listed source must be checked for currency and licence, and it has not been updated since 2022. It supports route planning and hazard exposure studies for CO2 pipelines, such as siting near population and geohazards. Related record: data-inl-history-ics-cyber-incidents is another DOE laboratory dataset in the catalogue, from a different domain.
